description: Control your Govee lights, plugs and appliances: turn them on or off, set brightness, colour and scenes, and read sensors. Start a workflow when a device goes offline, is turned on or off, or a temperature or humidity reading crosses a level.

govee_device_offline_trigger.description: Runs when a Govee device loses its connection, such as a plug that lost Wi-Fi or a sensor whose batteries ran out. Each check uses one request from your Govee key's daily allowance, so watch only the devices you need.

output.co2: Its CO2 reading, if it has one
output.device_id: The device's ID, for the Govee steps
output.humidity: Its humidity reading, if it has one
output.name: Its name in the Govee Home app
output.power: on or off, or empty if it can't say
output.temperature: Its temperature reading, if it has one

parameters.description: The Govee device to watch.
parameters.name: device_id

govee_device_online_trigger.description: Runs when a Govee device that was offline connects again. Each check uses one request from your Govee key's daily allowance, so watch only the devices you need.

output.temperature: Its temperature reading, if it has one

govee_reading_crosses_trigger.description: Runs when a Govee sensor's temperature, humidity or CO2 reading rises above or falls below a level you set, such as a freezer warming past -10. It runs once each time the level is crossed, not while the reading stays there. Each check uses one request from your Govee key's daily allowance, so watch only the devices you need.

output.co2: Its CO2 reading, if it has one
output.device_id: The device's ID, for the Govee steps
output.humidity: Its humidity reading, if it has one
output.name: Its name in the Govee Home app
output.power: on or off, or empty if it can't say
output.previous_value: The reading at the look before
output.reading: The reading watched: temperature, humidity or co2
output.temperature: Its temperature reading, if it has one
